attchmntText: KNR Constructions Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: KNR Constructions Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board approved the results on 13th November 2026. Revenue from operations was 78,965.7 lakhs for the quarter and 51,365.36 lakhs for the half year. Net profit after tax stood at 5,076.27 lakhs for the quarter and 56,304.45 lakhs for the half year. The half year profit included exceptional items of 57,786.93 lakhs from the transfer and surrender of subsidiary share capital. Total assets were 530,174.34 lakhs as at 30th September 2026. Cash and cash equivalents were 4,027.03 lakhs. The results include a limited review report.

voiceSummary: KNR Constructions Limited has scheduled an investor conference call to discuss financial performance for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The call is set for Monday, 16th November 2026, at 11:30 AM IST. Participants include Mr. K. Jalandhar Reddy, Executive Director and CFO, and Mr. K Venkatram Rao, General Manager of Finance and Accounts. The company has informed the BSE and NSE of this schedule pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations. Invitation copies are enclosed with the intimation. Pre-registration is requested via the provided link. Access numbers are listed for primary, toll-free USA, UK, Singapore, and Hong Kong regions. Strategic Growth Advisors Pvt. Ltd. handles RSVPs through Mr. Jigar Kavaiya and Ms. Krunali Shah. Contact numbers are plus 91 99206 02034 and plus 91 98209 87564.
